topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I stand here, watching the gate number flicker and change, the digital display a reminder of the time that's slipping away. The airport around me buzzes with the hum of life, yet I feel oddly isolated. My steps grow quicker as I find myself pacing back and forth, the edges of my vision narrowing. The air seems a bit too thick, each breath a little harder to draw. I glance at my watch, the hands ticking away the seconds, each one feeling like a small betrayal. The airport announcements blend into a muffled backdrop as I try to piece together my next move, each option narrowing, the paths diverging into uncertainty.
